cues.en: In this video, I will introduce you to the transpose operation.
cues.zh: 這支影片要介紹轉置運算。

cues.en: This is a very simple, very straightforward, easy to understand operation in linear algebra, but it's super important.
cues.zh: 這是線性代數裡非常簡單、直接、容易理解，卻又非常重要的操作。

cues.en: And so I will show you first the math in the slides.
cues.zh: 先透過投影片介紹數學概念。

cues.en: And then we'll switch to Python.
cues.zh: 接著切到 Python。

cues.en: And I'll show you how to transpose vectors and matrices in NumPy and in PyTorch.
cues.zh: 示範如何在 NumPy 與 PyTorch 裡，對向量和矩陣做轉置。

cues.en: So let's get started.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: Here we have a column vector.
cues.zh: 這裡有一個欄向量。

cues.en: And then we are going to transpose this column vector transpose operation is often indicated using a capital T in the superscript.
cues.zh: 我們要對它轉置。轉置運算通常用右上角的大寫 T 表示。

cues.en: So transposing means converting rows into columns and columns into rows.
cues.zh: 轉置的意思，就是把列變成欄，把欄變成列。

cues.en: So here we have a column vector.
cues.zh: 這裡是欄向量。

cues.en: Here we have a row vector resulting from the transpose operation.
cues.zh: 這裡則是轉置後得到的列向量。

cues.en: Notice that all of the elements are the same.
cues.zh: 注意，所有元素都相同。

cues.en: The order of the numbers is the same.
cues.zh: 數字的順序也相同。

cues.en: So we're not really changing the information that's contained Inside of this vector, we are only changing the orientation.
cues.zh: 我們沒有改變向量裡包含的資訊，只改變了方向。

cues.en: So column to row.
cues.zh: 也就是從欄變成列。

cues.en: Now you can transpose a row vector.
cues.zh: 也可以再對列向量做轉置。

cues.en: And that's going to bring us back to our original column vector.
cues.zh: 這就會回到原本的欄向量。

cues.en: So transposing a transpose.
cues.zh: 所以，對轉置結果再轉置，

cues.en: In other words double transposing undoes the original transpose.
cues.zh: 也就是連續轉置兩次，會抵銷原本的轉置。

cues.en: So double transpose you get back to the original vector.
cues.zh: 兩次轉置後，得到原本的向量。

cues.en: Now transposing a matrix is the same concept.
cues.zh: 轉置矩陣也是相同概念。

cues.en: You just have to be a little bit more mindful of which of preserving the column order into the rows.
cues.zh: 只是必須更注意，欄轉成列時，要保留正確順序。

cues.en: So when we transpose this matrix, it becomes this other matrix.
cues.zh: 對這個矩陣做轉置，就會變成另一個矩陣。

cues.en: This is now a matrix with two long columns.
cues.zh: 這是有兩個長欄的矩陣。

cues.en: Here we have two long rows.
cues.zh: 這裡則有兩個長列。

cues.en: Now the tricky thing is just to remember that the first column turns into the first row.
cues.zh: 比較容易搞錯的地方，是要記住：第一欄變成第一列。

cues.en: So, you know, if you would visualize this as you know, the T here being a pivot, and then you swivel the matrix up like this, if you would rotate this matrix, that's actually incorrect.
cues.zh: 如果把這裡的 T 想成支點，像這樣把矩陣旋轉上去，其實是不對的。

cues.en: because then the second column would be the first row.
cues.zh: 因為那樣，第二欄就會變成第一列。

cues.en: So make sure that the first column becomes the first row.
cues.zh: 所以，要確保第一欄變成第一列。

cues.en: The second column becomes the second row.
cues.zh: 第二欄變成第二列。

cues.en: Of course, this would continue for however many columns you have in this matrix would be rows in this matrix.
cues.zh: 當然，不管原本矩陣有多少欄，都會在這個矩陣裡變成對應的列。

cues.en: Now, you will not be surprised to learn that the transpose of a transpose matrix is gives us back the original matrix.
cues.zh: 你應該不意外，矩陣轉置後再轉置，就會回到原本的矩陣。

cues.en: So again, double transposing gives us back the same thing.
cues.zh: 所以，再說一次，連續轉置兩次會得到原來的內容。

cues.en: So in numpy there's actually a couple of ways you can transpose a vector.

cues.en: You can write numpy transpose NV like this so that you can use that to transpose.
